ns2:section.sectionText: The new NCAA rules allowing student athletes to benefit from their name, image, and likeness places an increasing importance on social media engagement and fan interactions for student athletes. With this changing landscape as context, the course will explore ways that sports leagues, teams, athletes, and fans curate and produce social and digital media. Students will study how social media affects fan engagement and how these platforms alter and expand sports content. Specifically, students will produce traditional or esports related content for social media channels.
